title: NPV skips non-numeric cells in ranges without advancing the period and stages discounts in x87
statement: In Excel 16.0.20131 and 16.0.20527, NPV(rate, value1, ...) skips text, logicals, and blank cells inside ranges and arrays without advancing the discount period (so NPV(0.1, Data!B1:B3, 1) over text cells B1:B3 returns 1/1.1, and all-text ranges return 0 while still checking rate = -1 for #DIV/0!), whereas direct scalar arguments coerce numeric text and logicals (NPV(0.1, TRUE) = 1/1.1). Each term divides by running stored powers of RN53(RN64(1 + rate)) and flushes subnormals.
basis: Measured across f3_financial (rows 3-4) and prefix_metadata (row 373) in Excel 16.0.20527.20088, 120 pinned NPV rows (NPV.json), and npv_excel_answers.txt (Excel 16.0.20527.20150), matching 3,259/3,259 full-bank and 120/120 pinned NPV rows.
